input.quote: 15.2 Representations and Warranties of Array. Array represents, warrants to Ono that, as of the Effective Date:
input.rationale: Article 15 contains only Effective Date representations (corporate authority, IP ownership/non-conflict, past Development compliance) plus a mutual disclaimer at 15.4 (p0711). There is no forward-looking performance or conformance warranty for the Materials Array supplies under Article 9, and no repair/replace/refund remedy; conformance is deferred to a clinical supply agreement and a future Supply/Quality Agreement (p0501, p0510) that only "shall contain ... product specifications" and are not yet executed. That is below the fallback (90-day conformance warranty with the stated remedies), so we insert a product warranty that Materials conform to specifications and are Manufactured under GMP and applicable Law, with a 90-day replace-or-refund remedy. The disclaimer itself is acceptable because it is mutual and opens "Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement", so it does not swallow the inserted express warranty.

ops.text: 15.4 Product Warranty; Remedy. Array represents and warrants that all Materials supplied to Ono by or on behalf of Array under Article 9 shall, at the time of delivery, (a) conform in all material respects to the applicable product specifications, (b) have been Manufactured in accordance with GMP and all other applicable Law, and (c) be free from any lien or encumbrance. Ono may reject any Materials that fail to comply with the foregoing warranty by written notice given within ninety (90) days after delivery or, in the case of latent defects not reasonably discoverable upon inspection, within ninety (90) days after discovery thereof, and Array shall, at Array's option, promptly replace such Materials at no additional cost to Ono or refund the amounts paid by Ono for such Materials.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an express warranty that Materials supplied under Article 9 conform to specifications and are Manufactured under GMP and applicable Law, with a ninety (90) day replace-or-refund remedy, since the Agreement currently gives us only Effective Date representations and defers conformance entirely to supply agreements not yet signed. Our playbook requires a conformance warranty with a real remedy; we are happy to align the mechanics with the clinical/commercial Quality Agreements.
proposal.summary: Insert product conformance/GMP warranty with 90-day replace-or-refund remedy for Materials supplied by Array.
